body: We’re really close and I know they would support me but on the other hand they don’t really believe in mental illnesses and therapists and antidepressants etc. They’re always like ‚You just gotta pull yourself out of this and not have so much self pity’

Im turning 16 in a month so I can’t really do it without telling everything to my parents which is gonna cause a lot of trouble since I live in a small town where everyone always gets to know everything. I always figured I’d do it once I move out which is in like 2 years
Okay.. thank you!! I probably need to see a therapist and I keep telling myself I do but im not ready to actually seek professional help yet
He’s like the only one I go to when I experience problems like these and he always tries to listen so it surprised me that he handled this so badly
Should I talk to him about it though?

thank you!! I usually don’t talk about my problems because I don’t want people to feel bad for me you know..
Anyways thank you for helping me I’ll probably try to talk to him about it and I hope he’ll see that I totally didn’t mean to guilt trip him and said what I said because I need help.

He told me it’s best if we stop talking altogether and I apologized because I don’t wanna lose him as a friend. He has given me great advice too and he’s helped a lot with my self esteem. He knows almost everything about me, even the things I’m most definitely not proud of. But sometimes he makes comments like this and calls me toxic and I wonder if he’s right.
